doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Favorite clarinetists: Picou and Big Eye Louis Nelson
summary: De De liked Picou and worked with him a lot; he praises Big Eye Louis's tone, who also worked at Luthjen's.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: I wondered about some of the clarinet players that you've played with. Who would be your favorite clarinet players in the old days, especially the older men that you remember when you were a boy? I like Pico.
Yes, Pico, in that old time jazz. And I worked with him a lot, you know that. Yes.
Did you ever work with Big Eye Louie?
Oh yes, indeed. Well yeah, Louie had more tone, what we call tonation in the clarinet, more tone. Beautiful playing, you know. Yes, I've heard of him. Louie was, yeah. I know him well.
He was at Lutches before you, right before you. Yes. No, I went to put him there.
You know he worked with us there.
Yeah, I went there a while with us.
See, now I went away. Yeah, he worked with us. Yeah, he worked with us.
You know, you had a job at Lutches? Yeah, see I had a job already at Lutches.
